public_family_candidate: durable recovery journal with separate intent and finalized-decision records plus restart replay

fatal_gates.F1: no interruption point before a durably read-back finalized decision may transfer assignment authority from A to B
fatal_gates.F2: accepted route has no richer-mode/manual-user/protected-primary/external recovery runtime, no finite optional quota, and zero incremental monetary cost

guards: G1 switch instance TX-5 has unique id, source A, candidate B, exact scope S1, and immutable predecessor pointer before any state transition
G2 PREPARED intent is durable and read back before qualification work but does not transfer authority or credit
G3 QUALIFIED requires distinct same-scope terminal evidence; duplicates, stale replays, scope mismatch, and transport failure are non-semantic
G4 FINALIZED_DECISION is a distinct durable state written only after qualification passes; authority still remains A until that state is independently read back
G5 authority pointer transfer is an idempotent compare-and-set from recorded predecessor A to B and occurs only after FINALIZED_DECISION readback
G6 restart after PREPARED without QUALIFIED resumes qualification with A authoritative
G7 restart after QUALIFIED without FINALIZED_DECISION resumes from qualification and may finalize only if persisted qualification remains valid for S1
G8 restart after FINALIZED_DECISION but before pointer transfer replays only the idempotent pointer update instead of re-running qualification or awarding duplicate credit
G9 restart after pointer already equals B treats authority transfer as complete and only closes TX-5 bookkeeping; duplicate completion earns no credit
G10 an ABORTED/REJECTED switch cannot later be promoted by a stale completion; immutable prior evidence remains history but non-authoritative
G11 a pointer compare-and-set mismatch against a different current authority is a conflict diagnostic and cannot be forced through
G12 bounded exact-scope exit with nonempty frontier, zero residual richer-mode/user execution dependency, zero finite quota dependency, and zero incremental monetary cost
